thread:
Maya: Heads-up — noticed a weird pattern on the KV dashboards this morning. kv_evictions_total jumped ~3x for a subset of hosts but kv_residency_percent barely moved and kv_frag_compactness increased.
Maya: attaching the short query I ran: `sum by(host) (increase(kv_evictions_total[5m]))` then cross-checked `avg by(host) (kv_residency_percent)` — mismatch on hosts b-12/ b-14.
Arun: hmm. Any chance this is sampling bias from the residency sampler window? We saw alignment artifacts before when sampler windows and eviction churn overlap.
Maya: possible. I also looked at long-context worker traces and saw memory growth on some connections that correlate with long chat sessions (~> 45k tokens). Not full OOM, but steady KV growth over time.
Priya: can you paste the grafana panels/queries? If sampler alignment is suspect we should check the raw counters (`kv_evictions_total` vs `kv_eviction_age_seconds_bucket`) and see if evictions are incrementing but fragments still counted as resident due to delayed residency decrement.
Maya: paste of two snippets:
```
# eviction spike per host
sum by(host) (increase(kv_evictions_total[10m]))

# residency sampled percent
avg_over_time(kv_residency_percent[10m])
```
Maya: host b-12 shows 180 evictions in 10m but residency avg stays at 78%. Fragmentation metric `kv_frag_compactness{host="b-12"}` dropped 0.12 -> 0.07
Ben: that smells like double-accounting: eviction counter increments when page chain compacts, but residency sampler still sees pointers to fragments until GC completes. We might be missing an `eviction_committed` signal.
Ben: proposal: add `kv_evictions_by_reason{reason="compaction|lru|oom_protect"}` and `kv_eviction_committed_total` emitted after compact/finalize. Also an `eviction_age` histogram to understand how long fragments float before commit.
Priya: +1. Also recommend small dashboard change: pair `increase(kv_evictions_total[5m])` with `increase(kv_eviction_committed_total[5m])` and `avg_over_time(kv_frag_compactness[5m])` so on-call can see commit lag.
Arun: for immediate triage — can we run a debug build on one of the b-12 hosts with `KV_TELEMETRY_DEBUG=1` to log eviction lifecycle traces? Keep it limited to one node.
Maya: started debug on b-12 at 3054321998. Logged a short sample:
```
[KV][evict] frag_id=0x7f2a3 commit_start
[KV][evict] frag_id=0x7f2a3 commit_end status=ok
[KV][residency] sample sees frag_id=0x7f2a3 -> still marked resident
```
Maya: so we do see commit_end before residency changes in some traces.
Arun: sounds like order-of-operations race between eviction finalizer and residency sampler. Sampler probably reads residency state from an in-memory view that only updates on the next GC tick.
Priya: short-term mitigation: widen sampler frequency or add an invalidate hook after commit. Long-term: emit `kv_eviction_committed_total` and make the residency sampler subscribe to commit events.
Ben: I'll open a tiny PR for the counters + a Grafana panel patch. Priya — can you own the sampler tweak experiment? If it reduces false positives we can roll to prod.
